name: Ecumenism
overview: Scripture affirms the exclusivity of Christ as the only way to the Father, emphasizing that no one can serve two masters or hold divided loyalties (Matthew 6:24; John 14:6). While Jesus prays for unity among believers that reflects the oneness of the Father and the Son, this unity is grounded in faith in Him alone (John 17:20-21). True unity involves being with Christ and gathering in His name, not compromising the gospel message or blending it with contrary teachings (Luke 11:23; Matthew 28:19).
